title: Crop past the image edge - canvas extension, edge snapping, exact-resolution mode
description: User request 2026-07-28. Photoshop-style crop: the box may leave the image, the new area fills with a picked colour (the outpaint prompt target), edges snap to the image bounds, and a third resolution type takes an exact WxH. Long form in brief.md.
acceptance: The crop rect may extend past every image edge in all three resolution types; Apply writes a file the full size of the rect
Pixels outside the source are filled with the colour from an MpiColorPicker in the crop panel (same primitive the Resize pad and Remove Background tools use), persisted per project
No auto-mask: the outpaint flow is prompting the model to fill the coloured area, which beats a painted mask
Crop edges snap to the image edges (and the box to the image centre when moving it) inside an 8-screen-px threshold, so a 1-2px accidental border is impossible
Snapping holds in ratio-locked mode by adjusting the SCALE, never by breaking the ratio

Third resolution type RESOLUTION: user types W and H, the box seeds at exactly those pixels centred on the image, is ratio-locked to W/H, and the output is resampled to exactly WxH. Resample happens ONLY in this type
Divisible-by no longer floors when rounding up overshoots the source - the overshoot is filled now. It stays hidden in RESOLUTION mode (exact dims win)
The managed view zooms out to fit image + crop union so a box larger than the image is fully visible; it must NOT refit mid-drag (scale changing under a live drag makes the rect chase the cursor)
Server /project/crop-media takes fill + optional outW/outH; Sharp extends by the outside margins before extract (extract alone throws out of bounds)
Video crop (js/utils/cropTool.js, normalized 0-1) is untouched in v1 - images only
A runnable check covers the snap maths and the extend/extract plan
